{{Otheruses|nightclub}}
A '''nightclub''' was an entertainment establishment which served [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] and usually featured loud [[Music/Legends|music]] and dancing. The [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] was a nightclub and a gambling hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref> [[Xerrol's Place]] was a swinging, popular nightclub aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. [[Glizband]]s played at Xerrol's Place.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
